messages:
ellie (CS): hey team — AcmeHealth asked for two things in onboarding: redacted PII samples from their dataset and a separate package of non-sensitive artifacts for embeddings verification. deadline is EOD Friday, can we assemble?
Jordan (Privacy): I can handle the redaction and evidence split. do we have a preferred redaction policy for example artifacts? we should avoid any raw customer ids, emails, or long free-text snippets.
Sam (Eng): for splitting & redaction we usually run DocSplitter v0.9 (internal). it produces: redacted_pdf, metadata.csv, and a hashed-id map. command we run:```bash
docsplitter --input acme_onboard.pdf --redact-policy basic --output /tmp/acme_pack````
Sam (Eng): note: make sure to set --preserve-schema for embeddings proofs, otherwise we lose column headings.
Jordan (Privacy): sounds good. redaction policy 'basic' strips emails, phone numbers, ssns and freeform PII. i'll also run a quick QA pass for context-preserving redaction (so we don't leak PHI).
Marco (Security): heads-up — any artifacts we hand back to the customer or store need an audit trail and must be encrypted at rest with customer KMS key if requested. Acme asked about BYOK in their DPA follow-up. if ops uploads to S3, use their KMS key alias.
ellie (CS): @Jordan can you confirm ETA? @Sam can you produce the non-sensitive bundle for embeddings? i'll notify the customer we have a plan. :calendar:
Jordan (Privacy): ETA by Thu 3pm PT for the redacted set. will post a short checklist when done.
Sam (Eng): i'll run the splitter now and push results to the onboarding bucket under s3://redwood-onboarding/acmehealth/3501234567/. sharing upload link after ops confirms.
ops-bot: upload completed: s3://redwood-onboarding/acmehealth/3501234567/package_v1.zip (size: 12.4MB). SHA256: 9f2a...e1c4
Marco (Security): verified envelope encryption and KMS key usage. recorded in the audit log.
ellie (CS): perfect — i'll send Acme a short note: we will provide (1) redacted sample bundle (2) non-sensitive embeddings artifacts (3) audit confirmation for encryption. will propose a quick call Fri if they want a walkthrough. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Privacy): also adding a short README in the bundle describing redaction rules and a contact pointer for appeal/clarify.
Sam (Eng): added README and sample script to regenerate the embeddings from the non-sensitive artifacts.
ellie (CS): thanks everyone. follow-up: if anything blocks, drop updates here — otherwise i'll close the loop externally after Thu 5pm PT.
